posts.text: Banger paper from Meta Superintelligence Labs on user simulators for agent training. This work trains MIMESIS, a 9B user simulator, on human conversations and 13 behavior patterns observed in real users. It beats Claude Opus 5 on behavioral fidelity by 13.4 points.

posts.author: testingcatalog
posts.text:
Pine AI launched Pine Computer, a cloud computer, harness, and runtime layer built for agentic tasks.

On SaaS-Bench v1.1, Pine Computer has the highest checkpoint score in the publisher's table: 78.3%, against 74.3% for Opus 5 with Claude Code. It also completed fewer whole tasks: 27.4% against 31.1%.
